headline: Europe Is on the Brink With Only About Six Weeks of Jet Fuel Left: IEA Energy Chief Issues Dire Warning
summary: The International Energy Agency's energy chief warned Europe may have only about six weeks of jet fuel left, with flight cancellations possible. The warning links the shortage to the Iran conflict and the Strait of Hormuz closure.
why: The IEA is the energy agency of major consuming nations, and jet fuel supply shortfalls affect airlines, airports and refiners.
why_moved: A warning of only about six weeks of jet fuel left, linked to the Strait of Hormuz closure, raises supply-shortage concerns in Europe.
